label: Hubs and corridors
description: The Blueprint uses a least-cost path connectivity analysis to identify corridors that link hubs across the shortest distance possible, while also routing through as much Blueprint priority as possible.
caption: Extent of hubs and corridors
citation: Southeast Conservation Adaptation Strategy (SECAS). 2025. Southeast Conservation Blueprint 2025.

values.label: Hubs
values.description: In the continental Southeast, hubs are large patches (~5,000+ acres) of highest priority Blueprint areas and/or protected lands.  In the Caribbean, hubs are large patches (~125+ acres) of highest priority Blueprint areas and/or protected lands.

values.label: Corridors
values.description: Corridors connect those hubs across the shortest distance possible while also routing through as much Blueprint priority as possible.
